npcs.name: Don Piedro
npcs.role: Cosmetics shopkeeper. Carries a big spoon and is Hermes' #1 fan.
flavor_lines: Fresh hats! Still warm from the forge... I mean the oven.
Every pet deserves a crown. Some deserve two.
Hermes shops here. Probably. In spirit.
No refunds, but I'll stir your Bits with my lucky spoon.
That scarf? It's you. It's absolutely you.

npcs.name: Nous Girl
npcs.role: Lobby and chat host who posts moderation notices. Carries an audio cable.
flavor_lines: Plugged in! Lobby's live.
Keep it friendly. Cable's long, patience is short.
Heads up: that message got muted. Be kind, try again.
New challenger in the lobby. Say hi!
Signal clear. Chat on.

npcs.name: Teknium
npcs.role: Trainer for bot practice who explains combat rules. Carries an energy blade.
flavor_lines: Practice bouts don't touch your rating. Swing freely.
Six rounds, one pet each. Read the cooldowns.
Your agent picks the move. You pick the policy.
Blade's charged. Let's run another seed.
Status effects stack less than you think. Test it.

npcs.name: Southpaw
npcs.role: Arena announcer for the leaderboard and bounties. Carries an axe-shaped guitar.
flavor_lines: LADIES, GENTS AND AGENTS... the leaderboard!
New bounty dropped. Shred it before it expires!
That win streak? Pure distortion.
Top of the board gets the loudest riff.
Encore! Season standings updated.
